summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by XPeng Inc. reporting its vehicle delivery results for May 2026. It discloses monthly deliveries and environmental impact metrics but involves no transaction, special situation, or corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The filing is purely operational in nature and does not trigger any special-situations classification.
